blocks.head: alt Either user invites the other user
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt UserX has key and the device exists
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt The cloud has a membership record for UserX and UserY exists

state_rules.rule:
eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : nils , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | (Device) 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : randomStr('KeyA', N) , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ....) , .....) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (randomStr('KeyA', N)) .

eq < Device | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (Key) 
= < Device | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('key' : DeviceKey , ..) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (Key) 
= < Device | ('key' : DeviceKey , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('key' : Key , 'trusted' : Trusted , ..) > $ UserX 'bind' Device | (Key) 
= < Device | ('key' : Key , 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'turnOn' Device 
= < Device | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'turnOnCloud' cloudA | (Device) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , ...) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' Device .

eq < Device | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : false , ..) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' Device 
= < Device | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : Device , ..) , UserY : ('device' : Device , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : Device , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < Device | (...) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Device) @ S < UserX | (..) > < Device | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Device | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, Device, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Device | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < Device | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, Device) @ S < UserX | (..) > < Device | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < cloudA | (...) > < Device | .... > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX, Device) @ S < UserX | (..) > < cloudA | (...) > < Device | .... > .

event_rules.label: rev6
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev6]: E @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < UserY | (....) > 
=> ep: ev6(UserX, UserY) @ S < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < UserY | (....) > .
